_comment: 🎚️ The transient state lane of `s.fem.3d`'s editor (✏️editor/🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/📊️results/🫧️transient): its mutation vocabulary `Fem3dResultsWindowTransientMutation` over `Fem3dResultsWindowTransient`, measured by the plugin bridge on the surface coordinate, claimed by `../../🧪️tests/🫧️mutate-fem-3d-1-any-editor-edit-results-transient` and backed by one committed vector per declared outcome class.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: `Fem3dResultsWindowTransientMutation` is the transient state lane of `s.fem.3d`'s ✏️editor/🎭️modes/✏️edit/🪟️windows/📊️results/🫧️transient surface: it holds the results window's playback clock (phase and direction), or none while playback is stopped. This is this repository's own editor state record, not a published format, so no third party implements it. What is under test is that each kind (`set-playback-clock`) changes exactly its own part of `Fem3dResultsWindowTransient`, that a kind declaring `no-op` leaves a record that already holds its value untouched with a warned `mutation.no-op`, and that every kind's computed inverse, read off the pre-mutation record, restores it exactly. Confidence comes from one committed, handcrafted (before, mutation, after, diff, outcome) vector per kind and declared outcome class under `../🧫️fixtures/`, exercised end to end through the production dispatch bridge, and from the inverse law as a metamorphic property.

candidatesConsidered.reason: An in-memory state container with arbitrary setter functions; it has no typed transient record, no per-kind mutation vocabulary and no computed inverse.
Persistent immutable collections; they version values structurally but define no mutation kinds, no-op guards or inverses over this surface's record.

referenceSurvey.whyNoneQualifies: `Fem3dResultsWindowTransient` is a state record defined by this repository with its own typed mutation vocabulary; generic state containers can hold its values but cannot adjudicate what each kind must change, when it is a no-op, or what its inverse is.

provenance.attribution: Handcrafted before/mutation/after vector authored against this state lane's own schema; the diff and diagnostics are the production dispatch's, reviewed against the after-snapshot.

fixtureManifests.notes: Starting playback from a stopped results window sets the clock to a quarter phase, running forward.
